lens: Editorial template builder: guides, legal, accessibility statement, 404
reads: research/cedar-springs-teardown-blueprint.md (moved from the repo root at the seed commit)
deliverables: Resources hub + 6 guides with byline "[OWNER NAME], RNC Landscaping" → /about/, published/updated <time> shown as "19 November 2026", reading progress (T1, motion policy)
Privacy, terms, accessibility statement (WCAG 2.2 AA, voluntary under Accessible BC; documents the Dark theme and Animations toggles)
Helpful 404 with search-style links to hubs
acceptance: A13#22: One <time datetime> format, displayed "19 November 2026" — verified by check-seo#time-format
gates: cd $WT/site && node tools/dev-setup.mjs --devtools   # once it exists (W1 build); before that: tsc --typeRoots /opt/node-tools/node_modules/@types
node build.mjs --offline-images --out=$OUT && SITE_DIST=$OUT node tools/check-all.mjs --no-build [--strict-redirects from W1 ia on]
PORT=$PORT SITE_DIST=$OUT node node_modules/playwright/cli.js test --trace off
node tools/a11y.mjs --themes=dark,light --widths=320,1440 --motion=off,on   # once qa lands; until then axe via the global helper
verifierLens: Art director + blueprint auditor: C2 section order, both themes at 5 widths, motion on/off, no-JS
portRule: builder = port; reviewer = port + 10; fixer = port + 20; evidence collector 4400
returns: {branch, head, base, files, gates, acceptance[], requests[]}
requests: .orchestra/requests/t-editorial.md (never edit a file outside owns; describe the change there)
